blind.about: Blinded adverts (ADR 2026-11.xp6d, knit-next #285). tags: m = HMAC-SHA256(presenceKey, label ‖ u64be(slot) ‖ u8(restart)); tag = CE 73 (90 | m[0] >> 4) ‖ m[1..13]; slot = floor(wallMs / slotMs). hasPrefix: 16 bytes starting CE 73 9_, saying nothing of whose. link: Alice, blinding, dials Bob's tag; her HELLO tells her tag (t) and the tag she dialed (a), his tells his; both proofs sign the HELLOs as sent, so a rewritten t fails. helloFields: t and a are read only behind a valid nonce, in any order, as exactly 32 lowercase hex digits; a letter whose exact-shape field appears twice is absent (null). Caps c0009 throughout.
